problem.explanation: Maintain two dictionaries to ensure a 1-to-1 mapping between characters in `s` and `t`. If there's a conflict, return False.
hints: Use two hash maps to keep track of the character mappings from s to t and from t to s.

problem.statement_markdown: Two strings `s` and `t` are isomorphic if the characters in `s` can be replaced to get `t`. All occurrences of a character must be replaced with another character while preserving the order of characters. No two characters may map to the same character, but a character may map to itself.
problem.title: Isomorphic strings
